review.why: Writes growth, lifecycle, content and brand resumes that attribute results carefully and keep revenue metrics distinct.
review.summary: Clarifies the specialty, channel, audience and budget authority, then gives evidence prompts per specialty. It keeps sourced pipeline, influenced pipeline, booked revenue and platform-attributed value apart, refuses to call a revenue-to-spend ratio profit, separates paid from organic results and credits team outcomes to the team. A worked example shows the claim to avoid.
strengths: Metric definitions, models and reporting windows are preserved
Brand and editorial work can rest on deliverables when impact was not measured
No invented downstream impact from email opens
cautions: Instructions only: no templates or scripts
Calculations only from compatible inputs the user supplies
